naslov: Indiana hosts Philadelphia in conference showdown
tekst:
Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, second in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (2-2, ninth in the Eastern Conference)
              Indianapolis; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EDT
              LINE: 76ers -1.5; over/under is 238.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Indiana hosts Philadelphia in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams.
              Indiana finished 19-63 overall and 15-37 in Eastern Conference games last season. The Pacers gave up 120.4 points per game while committing 20.9 fouls last season.
              Philadelphia finished 45-37 overall and 27-25 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The 76ers averaged 115.9 points per game while shooting 46.2% from the field and 34.9% from 3-point range last season.
              INJURIES: Pacers: Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Ivica Zubac: out (ankle), Andrew Nembhard: day to day (neck), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl), T.J. McConnell: out (hamstring).
              76ers: Ariel Hukporti: out for season (achilles), Jabari Walker: day to day (knee), Joel Embiid: day to day (heel), Tacko Fall: day to day (quadriceps), Dominick Barlow: out (back), VJ Edgecombe: day to day (abdomen).
